quest.description: A proving-road built by an order long dead: one winding path, sown with snares, from the iron gate to the far sanctum. Reach the sanctum alive.

0,0.description: An iron gate stands rusted open at the mouth of the gauntlet, its arch inscribed: WALK AND BE WEIGHED. The single path beyond runs crooked into the dark.

1,0.description: The first stretch of the proving-road, worn into a groove by centuries of anxious feet.

2,0.description: The passage narrows and the walls show fresh gouges. Old stains map where earlier pilgrims stood too long.

2,1.description: A turning in the road. A pilgrim's pack lies against the wall, its owner nowhere in sight.

2,2.description: A waystation with a dry fountain at its center. The silence here has weight.

3,2.description: A votive alcove off the main road, its offerings buried under a fall of dust and rubble.

1,2.description: The road climbs through a seam in the rock, each step cut shallower than the last.

0,2.description: A gallery of leaning statues, every face worn blank. Thin wires of light cross the floor between them.

0,3.description: A high, narrow walk. Far below, water moves in the dark.

0,4.description: A tollhouse at the road's high corner. Its keeper never left.

1,4.description: The floor here is a mosaic of pressure-worn tiles, several sitting a hair too proud.

2,4.description: A resting cell for pilgrims, stone bunks bare. A supply niche still holds a final kindness.

3,4.description: The winnowing hall. Scorch marks fan across the walls in overlapping arcs.

3,3.description: The last chamber before the sanctum stair. Something has been waiting here a very long time.

4,3.description: The sanctum stair, each step inlaid with a worn silver line pointing the way.

4,2.description: The far sanctum. Light falls from an unseen height onto a floor of unbroken white stone — the end of the gauntlet.

characters.name: Gauntlet Harpy
characters.description: It roosts above the dry fountain, all wing and talon, and drops without a sound on those who linger.

characters.name: Toll Harpy
characters.description: It perches on the tollhouse sill, one talon extended and open. The toll it collects is not coin.

characters.name: Sanctum Mage
characters.description: The gauntlet's final judge, robed and utterly still, tracing wards in the air that flare as you approach.

items.name: Pilgrim's Blade
items.description: A straight, plain sword left as an offering. The order judged it; the order kept it.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A small vial of red liquid that restores health.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: Hidden beneath a proud tile — a reward for the careful, or the lucky.

objective.description: Survive the gauntlet and stand in the far sanctum.
